- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

A fixed mock length of `n` currently produces `n - 1` valid training tokens after appending EOD and applying the next-token shift. Generate `n` content tokens so, for example, a 65536-token configuration produces 65536 valid tokens before alignment padding, capped at `--seq-length`.

Apply this convention to distribution, CSV, and verification modes. Adjust the shared MockSFT THD/SBHD padding and truncation, and mask padding by position so EOD remains a valid target when it is also the pad token. Preserve the existing vocabulary bounds and document the length convention in the CLI help.

## Issue tracking

Small bug fix; no linked issue.

## Validation

- 46 mock-focused CPU tests passed: 38 new regression cases plus 8 existing tests, including vocabulary bounds. Coverage includes length 1, 64K, CP padding, truncation, verification document wrapping, and `pad == eod`.
- CPU validation loaded the real dataset modules without the unrelated training bootstrap and global distributed fixtures because the host runs Python 3.11. Full distributed/GPU tests were not run.
- `BASE_REF=dev CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` completed; Black, isort, Pylint, and Ruff passed. The script's optional mypy step was unavailable in the local lint environment.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Contribution process

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run `tools/autoformat.sh` on my PR

nodes.body:
This pull request requires additional validation before any workflows can run on NVIDIA's runners.

Pull request vetters can view their responsibilities [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/vetters).

Contributors can view more details about this message [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/contributors).

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

## Strict review

Findings: **CRITICAL: 0 · IMPORTANT: 1 · SUGGESTION: 0**.

The content-length and positional loss-mask changes are consistent with the intended convention. However, preserving the extra valid token can move a sample across an alignment boundary without increasing the packing scheduler’s capacity, breaking an existing accepted dynamic-CP configuration. Overall risk: **moderate**, localized to alignment-boundary configurations.

### Suggested repair for the inline compatibility finding

In [validate_args](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/megatron/training/arguments.py#L1907-L1921), replace the capacity-defaulting/check portion at lines 1912–1921 with the following. This mirrors the dataset’s CP/SP padding divisor and leaves the preceding `total_cp_ranks` selection intact:

```python
        cp_divisor = (
            args.data_parallel_size * args.context_parallel_size * 2
            if args.dynamic_context_parallel
            else (args.context_parallel_size * 2 if args.context_parallel_size > 1 else 1)
        )
        sp_divisor = args.tensor_model_parallel_size if args.sequence_parallel else 1
        padding_divisor = cp_divisor * sp_divisor
        max_padded_length = (
            (args.seq_length + padding_divisor - 1)
            // padding_divisor
            * padding_divisor
        )
        if args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank is None:
            args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank = getattr(args, "max_seqlen_per_cp_rank", None)
        if args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank is None:
            args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank = (
                max_padded_length + total_cp_ranks - 1
            ) // total_cp_ranks
        assert total_cp_ranks * args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank >= max_padded_length, (
            f'Packed sequence buffer size ({total_cp_ranks * args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank}) '
            f'must be >= padded single sequence max length ({max_padded_length})'
        )
```

This is a source-reasoned suggestion, not an executed fix; verify it before adoption. Add the dataset-to-scheduler regression described inline, retaining the new valid-token counts rather than shortening samples again.

Validation was static only; no tests were executed. The style guide referenced by the rubric was absent from the supplied base snapshot.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex*

<!-- nemo-ci-review-rendering:inline-v1 -->
<!-- nemo-ci-formal-review:06daa2279a7a18067f868d7ece94b6e4ed97c8b595ed9dda00e62bbb716155e2:62a11b63896c50ef10784f9525da06d608d595839a49e06abb6867b4dc269158 -->

**[IMPORTANT Compatibility] Account for the new length at the packing-capacity boundary**

**Failure:** Use `--use-varlen-dataset --mock-data --dynamic-context-parallel --calculate-per-token-loss`, DP=2, CP=1, no sequence parallelism, `--seq-length 9`, and a fixed distribution with `min_seq_len=max_seq_len=mean_seq_len=9`. Leave `--max-seqlen-per-dp-cp-rank` unset. The [argument default](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/megatron/training/arguments.py#L1907-L1921) is 5 per rank, but the [dataset divisor](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/megatron/training/datasets/sft_dataset.py#L92-L111) is 4. Returning nine content tokens now produces `original_seq_len=9`, `padded_seq_len=12` in [MockVarlenDataset](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/megatron/training/datasets/varlen_dataset.py#L513-L521). The scheduler consequently requests four CP ranks (`2**ceil(log2(12/5))`) and hits the [two-rank availability assertion](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/megatron/core/datasets/data_schedule_utils.py#L640-L644), aborting before training. In the [base implementation](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c75a269efd3fdf6d82ba5a07fff00ed40f350cba/megatron/training/datasets/sft_dataset.py#L304-L335), this same configuration emitted eight shifted/aligned tokens and fit. Expected: retain nine valid targets and schedule the physically padded sample successfully.

**Correction:** Update the final packing-capacity default and validation in `validate_args` to account for `ceil(seq_length / dataset_padding_divisor) * dataset_padding_divisor`, including dynamic DP×CP and SP alignment. The default must accommodate that physical length; an explicitly insufficient limit should fail during argument validation. A suggested replacement is in the review body. Do not restore `length-1` or truncate away the ninth valid target to make it fit.

**Preservation and acceptance — proposed checks, not executed:**
- Extend the [CPU dataset setup](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/tests/unit_tests/data/test_mock_dataset_lengths.py#L29-L48) with dynamic CP enabled and DP=2. For fixed length/ceiling 9, assert original length 9, padded length 12, loss-mask sum 9, and a valid final EOD target. The resolved default must be 6; `DefaultDynamicCPScheduler(6, cp_size=1, dp_size=2, microbatch_group_size_per_vp_stage=None).get_groups_and_subsamples([(0, 12), (1, 12)])` must return `[[[0], [0]], [[1], [1]]]` without an assertion. Explicit limit 5 must reject early; 6 must pass.
- For the neighboring aligned ceiling 8 on the same topology, retain default capacity 4 and padded length 8. A seven-content-token sample must still have seven valid targets and one masked alignment slot.
- Retain the [existing new length tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/tests/unit_tests/data/test_mock_dataset_lengths.py#L88-L144): lengths 1 and 65536 survive the shift; oversize samples retain `min(length, seq_length)` valid targets; both SFT layouts keep the terminal EOD loss-enabled even when `pad == eod`.

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Mock length configurations must describe valid tokens after the label shift."""
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.training.datasets.sft_dataset import MockSFTDataset, MockSFTLowLevelDataset
+from megatron.training.datasets.varlen_dataset import MockVarlenDataset
+
+
+def _distribution(length: int) -> dict[str, str | int | float]:
+    return {
+        "mode": "distribution",
+        "type": "lognormal",
+        "min_seq_len": length,
+        "max_seq_len": length,
+        "mean_seq_len": length,
+        "lognormal_sigma": 1.1,
+        "vocab_size": 65537,
+    }
+
+
+def _config(length: int, *, cp: int = 1, pad: int | None = 0) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        tokenizer=SimpleNamespace(eod=0, pad=pad, vocab_size=65537),
+        sequence_length=length,
+        dynamic_context_parallel=False,
+        context_parallel_size=cp,
+        data_parallel_size=1,
+        sequence_parallel_size=1,
+    )
+
+
+def _dataset(
+    dataset_type: type[MockSFTDataset], low_level: MockSFTLowLevelDataset, config: SimpleNamespace
+) -> MockSFTDataset:
+    # These CPU-only contracts do not need tokenizer/distributed initialization.
+    dataset = dataset_type.__new__(dataset_type)
+    dataset.dataset = low_level
+    dataset.indices = np.array([0])
+    dataset.config = config
+    return dataset
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("length", [1, 7, 8, 65536])
+def test_mock_distribution_returns_configured_content_length(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, length: int
+) -> None:
+    """The sampled length counts content tokens before EOD is appended."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(MockSFTLowLevelDataset, "size", 2)
+    dataset = MockSFTLowLevelDataset(**_distribution(length))
+    assert len(dataset[0]) == length
+    assert dataset[0][0] == 1
+    assert dataset[0][-1] == length
+
+
+def test_mock_csv_lengths_are_content_lengths(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    """CSV lengths follow the same convention as sampled distribution lengths."""
+    path = tmp_path / "lengths.csv"
+    path.write_text("length\n1\n7\n8\n")
+    dataset = MockSFTLowLevelDataset(mode="file", path=str(path), vocab_size=65537)
+    assert [len(dataset[i]) for i in range(len(dataset))] == [1, 7, 8]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("length", [1, 2, 7])
+def test_mock_verification_returns_full_length_across_documents(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, length: int
+) -> None:
+    """Verification mode supplies every requested token, including document wrapping."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(MockSFTLowLevelDataset, "size", 2)
+    documents = [np.array([11, 12]), np.array([21])]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "megatron.training.datasets.sft_dataset.IndexedDataset", lambda path: documents
+    )
+    settings = _distribution(length)
+    settings.update(mode="verification", data_path="unused")
+    dataset = MockSFTLowLevelDataset(**settings)
+    expected = np.array([11, 12, 21, 11, 12, 21, 11])[:length]
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(dataset[0], expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("length", [1, 7, 8, 9, 65536])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp", [1, 2])
+def test_varlen_config_length_survives_shift_and_padding(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, length: int, cp: int
+) -> None:
+    """A JSON length n yields n valid targets and masks only the alignment padding."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(MockSFTLowLevelDataset, "size", 2)
+    config = _config(length, cp=cp, pad=None)
+    config.varlen_mock_dataset_config_json = json.dumps(_distribution(length))
+    low_level = MockVarlenDataset.build_low_level_dataset(None, config)
+    sample = _dataset(MockVarlenDataset, low_level, config)[0]
+    divisor = cp * 2 if cp > 1 else 1
+    expected_padded = ((length + divisor - 1) // divisor) * divisor
+
+    assert sample["original_seq_len"].item() == length
+    assert sample["padded_seq_len"].item() == expected_padded
+    assert sample["tokens"].numel() == expected_padded
+    assert sample["loss_mask"].sum().item() == length
+    assert sample["labels"][length - 1].item() == config.tokenizer.eod
+    assert sample["loss_mask"][length - 1].item() == 1
+    assert torch.equal(sample["tokens"][:length], torch.arange(1, length + 1))
+    assert torch.equal(sample["labels"][: length - 1], torch.arange(2, length + 1))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("length", [8, 9, 10, 16])
+def test_varlen_truncation_preserves_maximum_valid_length(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, length: int
+) -> None:
+    """Clipping retains seq_length content tokens plus the final EOD target."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(MockSFTLowLevelDataset, "size", 2)
+    low_level = MockSFTLowLevelDataset(**_distribution(length))
+    sample = _dataset(MockVarlenDataset, low_level, _config(8, cp=2))[0]
+    assert sample["original_seq_len"].item() == 8
+    assert sample["padded_seq_len"].item() == 8
+    assert sample["loss_mask"].sum().item() == 8
+    assert sample["tokens"].tolist() == list(range(1, 9))
+    assert sample["labels"].tolist() == list(range(2, 9)) + [0]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("format", ["thd", "sbhd"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("length", [1, 7, 8, 9])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("pad", [0, -1])
+def test_shared_sft_path_keeps_configured_valid_length(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, format: str, length: int, pad: int
+) -> None:
+    """Both SFT layouts preserve the valid length even when EOD is also padding."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(MockSFTLowLevelDataset, "size", 2)
+    low_level = MockSFTLowLevelDataset(**_distribution(length), format=format)
+    sample = _dataset(MockSFTDataset, low_level, _config(8, cp=2, pad=pad))[0]
+    valid = min(length, 8)
+    padded = 8 if format == "sbhd" else ((valid + 3) // 4) * 4
+    assert sample["tokens"].numel() == padded
+    assert sample["loss_mask"].sum().item() == valid
+    assert sample["labels"][valid - 1].item() == 0
+    assert sample["loss_mask"][valid - 1].item() == 1
+    if format == "thd":
+        assert sample["cu_seqlens"].tolist() == [0, padded]

@@ -534,7 +534,7 @@ def test_generated_mock_tokens_stay_within_tokenizer_vocab(
     low_level_dataset = dataset_cls.build_low_level_dataset("", config)
     tokens = low_level_dataset[0]
 
-    assert tokens.size == 19
+    assert tokens.size == 20
     assert tokens.min() >= 1
     assert tokens.max() < tokenizer.vocab_size
     assert tokens[:9].tolist() == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 1, 2]

In the [base implementation](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c75a269efd3fdf6d82ba5a07fff00ed40f350cba/megatron/training/datasets/sft_dataset.py#L304-L335), this same configuration emitted eight shifted/aligned tokens and fit. Expected: retain nine valid targets and schedule the physically padded sample successfully.

**Correction:** Update the final packing-capacity default and validation in `validate_args` to account for `ceil(seq_length / dataset_padding_divisor) * dataset_padding_divisor`, including dynamic DP×CP and SP alignment. The default must accommodate that physical length; an explicitly insufficient limit should fail during argument validation. A suggested replacement is in the review body. Do not restore `length-1` or truncate away the ninth valid target to make it fit.

**Preservation and acceptance — proposed checks, not executed:**
- Extend the [CPU dataset setup](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/tests/unit_tests/data/test_mock_dataset_lengths.py#L29-L48) with dynamic CP enabled and DP=2. For fixed length/ceiling 9, assert original length 9, padded length 12, loss-mask sum 9, and a valid final EOD target. The resolved default must be 6; `DefaultDynamicCPScheduler(6, cp_size=1, dp_size=2, microbatch_group_size_per_vp_stage=None).get_groups_and_subsamples([(0, 12), (1, 12)])` must return `[[[0], [0]], [[1], [1]]]` without an assertion. Explicit limit 5 must reject early; 6 must pass.
- For the neighboring aligned ceiling 8 on the same topology, retain default capacity 4 and padded length 8. A seven-content-token sample must still have seven valid targets and one masked alignment slot.
- Retain the [existing new length tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/tests/unit_tests/data/test_mock_dataset_lengths.py#L88-L144): lengths 1 and 65536 survive the shift; oversize samples retain `min(length, seq_length)` valid targets; both SFT layouts keep the terminal EOD loss-enabled even when `pad == eod`.

## Strict review

Findings: **CRITICAL: 0 · IMPORTANT: 1 · SUGGESTION: 0**.

The content-length and positional loss-mask changes are consistent with the intended convention. However, preserving the extra valid token can move a sample across an alignment boundary without increasing the packing scheduler’s capacity, breaking an existing accepted dynamic-CP configuration. Overall risk: **moderate**, localized to alignment-boundary configurations.

### Suggested repair for the inline compatibility finding

In [validate_args](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/c0d20f5a021825c8c261ba0c7107edb986305690/megatron/training/arguments.py#L1907-L1921), replace the capacity-defaulting/check portion at lines 1912–1921 with the following. This mirrors the dataset’s CP/SP padding divisor and leaves the preceding `total_cp_ranks` selection intact:

```python
        cp_divisor = (
            args.data_parallel_size * args.context_parallel_size * 2
            if args.dynamic_context_parallel
            else (args.context_parallel_size * 2 if args.context_parallel_size > 1 else 1)
        )
        sp_divisor = args.tensor_model_parallel_size if args.sequence_parallel else 1
        padding_divisor = cp_divisor * sp_divisor
        max_padded_length = (
            (args.seq_length + padding_divisor - 1)
            // padding_divisor
            * padding_divisor
        )
        if args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank is None:
            args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank = getattr(args, "max_seqlen_per_cp_rank", None)
        if args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank is None:
            args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank = (
                max_padded_length + total_cp_ranks - 1
            ) // total_cp_ranks
        assert total_cp_ranks * args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank >= max_padded_length, (
            f'Packed sequence buffer size ({total_cp_ranks * args.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank}) '
            f'must be >= padded single sequence max length ({max_padded_length})'
        )
```

This is a source-reasoned suggestion, not an executed fix; verify it before adoption. Add the dataset-to-scheduler regression described inline, retaining the new valid-token counts rather than shortening samples again.

Validation was static only; no tests were executed. The style guide referenced by the rubric was absent from the supplied base snapshot.
